name: @pipeworx/mcp-the-guardian

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search The Guardian newspaper archive (UK-based international news outlet) for articles by keyword, section, tag, or date range. Returns headlines with author, section, publication date, web URL, and optional full body text. Use for "Guardian coverage of X" or UK/EU-perspective news on world events.

tools.name: item
tools.description: Fetch a single Guardian article by its content ID (e.g. "world/2024/jan/15/..."). Returns full body text, tags, related elements, and references. Use after search returns an article you want the full text of.

tools.name: sections
tools.description: List The Guardian's content sections (Politics, World, Sport, Culture, Environment, etc.). Optionally filter by name substring via q. Returns section IDs and titles for use as filters in search().

tools.name: tags
tools.description: Browse The Guardian's content tags (topics, series, contributors, and keywords like "climate-change" or "long-read"). Filter by q substring, type (keyword/series/contributor), or section. Returns tag IDs for use in search(tag=...).

tools.name: editions
tools.description: List The Guardian's geographic editions (UK, US, Australia, International). Returns edition IDs and hostnames. Use to discover edition-specific content streams before filtering search() by edition.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-the-guardian forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the the-guardian pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
